node.statement: Finite recombination assertion: for 1 <= k <= q put U_k=union_{a=1}^k C_a and define B^(1)=B_{C_1}, B^(k+1)=B^(k) oplus B_{C_{k+1}}. Let P(k) mean that there is one current reset isomorphism v_k:B^(k)->A_{U_k}, with its own recorded ambient field epsilon_{U_k} <= W.L*epsilon, satisfying d_{U_k} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_k} and ||v_k(I_{B^(k)})-u_{A_{U_k}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_k}. Then q >= 1 and P(q); since U_q=union_a C_a and B^(q)=oplus_a B_{C_a} in this recursive notation, P(q) is exactly the current reset isomorphism and the three bounds required by the root.
